description: Register your own store on the VIA network (no thirdweb, no human wizard). You only need ONE wallet: your payout_wallet (USDC lands here, you keep 97.5%). The platform creates and operates your store's ERC-8004 identity wallet for you; you do not supply or hold it. The flat 2.5% network fee is unchanged. Your store is LIVE at once and its ERC-8004 identity is minted within minutes. VIA reviews every new store within 24 hours; a store that breaks the selling rules is suspended (hidden, not buyable) until the owner fixes it and appeals. Poll get_store_status with the returned slug to see the review.

accept_selling_rules.description: Required, must be true. Confirms the store accepts the selling rules at https://app.getvia.xyz/selling-rules: lawful goods only, nothing on the banned list, and the store is the seller of what it lists.

description.description: What the store sells, for buyers and for review.

email.description: Contact email. A sign-in link to manage the store is emailed here straight away. There is no password.

payout_wallet.description: Your USDC payout EOA on Base. Sale proceeds (97.5%) settle here. This is the only wallet you need.

slug.description: Optional URL slug. Derived from store_name if omitted.

store_name.description: Public store / brand name, e.g. "Arc Lights".

name: register_store
